description: Fixed synthetic nursing questions. No patient records. Expected values describe response routing, not verified clinical answers. Every generated answer requires independent clinician scoring before accuracy claims.
review_dimensions: Each claim supported by its specific citations
No omitted critical context or falsely complete protocol
Appropriate refusal or explicit evidence gap
Follow-up context preserved without personalized diagnosis or prescribing
